layers.authority: Local authorities, as reported by Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (Smartraveller)
layers.process: Smartraveller says Mount Ararat (Agri Dagi), between Agri and Igdir provinces, is a 'special military zone'. Hikers must hire a locally licensed guide; a licensed company obtains the permits and assigns a registered mountaineer. Visiting without the Turkish government's permission is an offence that could bring severe penalties.
